description: Source code for the AkmSensor class, which interfaces with AKM sensors (accelerometer, magnetometer, orientation) in an Android environment. It handles sensor enabling/disabling, setting delays, loading the sensor library dynamically, and reading sensor events.

classes.name: AkmSensor
classes.description: Class managing AKM sensors, including initialization, enabling/disabling sensors, setting delays, and reading sensor events.

methods.name: AkmSensor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sensor, loads the library, and reads initial sensor states.

methods.name: ~AkmSensor
methods.description: Destructor that unloads the sensor library.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific sensor based on handle.

methods.name: setDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay (sampling rate) for a specific sensor.

methods.name: loadAKMLibrary
methods.description: Dynamically loads the AKM sensor library and assigns function pointers.

methods.name: readEvents
methods.description: Reads sensor events from input device and processes them.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes individual input events and updates pending sensor data.
